'''IK-48''' was [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader's]] personal [[Prowler 1000 seeker droid/Legends|probe droid]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Otavon XII]]. During the early years of the [[New Order/Legends|New Order]], IK-48 accompanied Vader into the planet's forest when the latter learned that the [[Ovoni]] rebels, who were disrupting the [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|All Terrain Armored Transport]] factory with their constant attacks, had [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] with them. When Vader was attacked by a [[Sugati]], IK-48 identified a [[sound emitter]] as the source of the Sugati's blind rage and aggression.<ref name="thb" />
